summary: Copán is a Maya archaeological site in the Copán Department of western Honourable Honduras, near the Guatemalan border. It served as the capital of a major Classic period kingdom from the 5th to 9th centuries AD. The note stresses its position at the far southeastern edge of Mesoamerica, on the frontier with the Isthmo-Colombian cultural region, where it was nearly surrounded by non-Maya peoples.
one_line: Copán is a Classic-period Maya archaeological site and former kingdom capital in western Honduras, near the Guatemalan border.
key_facts: Copán is an archaeological site of the Maya civilization.
Copán is located in the Copán Department of western Honduras.
Copán is located not far from the border with Guatemala.
Copán was the capital city of a major Classic period kingdom.
The Classic period kingdom centered on Copán dates from the 5th to 9th centuries AD.
Copán was located in the extreme southeast of the Mesoamerican cultural region.
Copán sat on the frontier with the Isthmo-Colombian cultural region.
Copán was almost surrounded by non-Maya peoples.
